title: Ride-Hailing & Super-App Analytics
thesis: Snowflake powers super-app intelligence — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time demand-supply balance, ML.FORECAST projects demand by zone, and Cortex AI optimizes pricing and driver allocation across transport, food, and payments

talking_points: 100 million trips per month across ride, food, and courier — fulfillment at 89%.
2 million active driver-partners — current online supply at 340,000 during peak.
12 zones in Jakarta below 80% fulfillment right now — driver supply shortage.
tabs.call_out: 89% fulfillment — 12 Jakarta zones below 80%, supply shortage now

transition.line: Let's look at what's causing the supply gap.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts demand 30 minutes ahead per zone — enables proactive driver allocation.
Surge pricing at 1.8x in South Jakarta — demand 2.4x supply at 6pm peak.
Incentive spend of Rp 45B/week — but ROI declining from 3.2x to 2.1x over 4 weeks.
show: Show demand forecast vs actual by zone
Point at incentive ROI declining trend
tabs.call_out: Incentive ROI declining 3.2x→2.1x — smarter allocation needed

transition.line: Pricing and incentives need optimization. Let's see driver economics.

talking_points: Average driver earning Rp 180K/day — 15% below 6-month ago (competition effect).
Top 10% drivers earn 3.5x the median — zone selection and multi-service adoption.
Driver churn at 8% monthly — primarily among low-earning first-90-day drivers.
tabs.call_out: 8% monthly driver churn — earnings 15% below 6 months ago

transition.line: Now let the VP ask about marketplace health.

talking_points: Bimo asks: 'What's the current fulfillment rate across all services?'
Cortex Analyst queries — returns 89% overall: ride 87%, food 91%, courier 93%.
Follow-up: 'Generate a driver allocation plan for the 12 low-fulfillment zones' — AI produces plan.
show: Switch to advisory for allocation plan
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: marketplace analytics + operations advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, native ML.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Indonesia's ride-hailing market: US$7.5B — dominated by Gojek and Grab.
500 million demand events per month — real-time processing at 5-minute intervals.
show: Point at real-time demand data flow
tabs.call_out: One platform, 5-minute refresh, native ML for demand forecasting

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for super-app operations.
